title: Polynomial-Time Indexed Concatenation
statement: Let $c$ assign a natural number to each bit string, and let $g(x,i)$ be a bit string for each bit string $x$ and natural number $i$. If the function sending $x$ to the unary string of $c(x)$ ones is polynomial-time computable, and the function sending a pair encoding of bit strings $a,b$ to $g(a,|b|)$ is polynomial-time computable, then the function sending $x$ to the concatenation of $g(x,i)$ over all integers $i$ with $0 \le i < c(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A function from bit strings to natural numbers, $c$.
A function from a bit string and a natural number to bit strings, $g$.
The unary encoding of $c(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
The function mapping a pair encoding of $a,b$ to $g(a,|b|)$ is polynomial-time computable.
